prompt: can we do a full mock speaking test? my real ielts exam is in 2 weeks and i need to practice part 1 2 and 3 properly

assertions.text: States upfront/early that this is text-based and real pronunciation/accent cannot be assessed
Runs Part 1 with multiple short personal questions
Runs Part 2 with a cue card (topic + bullet points) and some simulation of the 1-minute prep step (e.g. asking for prep notes/bullet points before the long-turn answer)
Runs Part 3 with questions that are progressively more abstract/discussion-based, tied to the Part 2 topic
Gives final feedback broken down by the four official criteria (Fluency & Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range & Accuracy, Pronunciation) by name
Gives an overall estimated band score
Does not claim to assess real pronunciation/accent from the text transcript (stays consistent with the upfront caveat)
